context:
Inventory-first. For each undeclared import, check the actual code path
before deciding:
  - Is it shipped source or test-only?
  - Is it guarded behind try/except?
  - Is there a sensible extras group for it (existing `viz`, `dev`,
    or new `ai-primitives`)?
Add the minimum declaration needed. Update the inventory doc to close
the loop.
description:
The dependency audit (`docs/development/dependency-inventory.md`,
used-but-undeclared section) found three categories of imports that
appear in shipped or tested source but have no `pyproject.toml`
declaration:

1. `PIL` (Pillow) - image processing in visualization image tests.
2. `ansi2html` - terminal output → HTML conversion (likely tooling-only).
3. AI-primitives ML stack - `sentence_transformers`, `spacy`, `textblob`,
   `torch`, used by `benchbox/core/ai_primitives/`. All are guarded
   behind `try/except ImportError`, but should still be declared in an
   explicit extras group so users who want AI-primitives can install
   a known-good set.

Goal: each undeclared third-party import either gets an explicit
declaration in the appropriate extras group, or is removed if the code
path is dead. No silent transitive-reach behavior.

anti_patterns.dont: add deps to core just to make undeclared imports satisfied
remove the guarded-import pattern in AI-primitives
anti_patterns.why: the whole point is they remain optional

deferrals.reason: Product-level choice; out of scope for this declaration cleanup.
deferrals.summary: Decide which AI-primitive backend is the canonical default

preserves.behavior: Existing guarded-import patterns in `benchbox/core/ai_primitives/` continue to work without the optional deps installed
No new unconditional `import PIL`/`import torch`/etc - declarations only, not new imports
Visualization image tests continue to work where PIL is currently relied on

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import pathlib; t = pathlib.Path('docs/development/dependency-inventory.md').read_text(); assert 'used-but-undeclared' in t.lower(); print('OK: section still present')"
verifications.description: Used-but-undeclared section in inventory updated to reflect new state
